snapshot.fact: FY2025 total revenue was $22.2B, down from $22.9B in 2024; FY2025 operating income $2.3B vs adjusted operating income $3.1B (gap reflects 'Impairments and other charges').
Two reporting segments: Completion and Production (Q4 2025 revenue $3.3B) and Drilling and Evaluation (Q4 2025 revenue $2.4B); 2025 operating margins 17% and 15% respectively.
Over 46,000 employees as of Dec 31, 2025, across 146 nationalities and more than 70 countries (down from nearly 48,000 at end of 2024 per Zacks).
Q2 2026 revenue $5.7B (C&P $3.2B, D&E $2.5B); North America $2.3B, International $3.4B; net income $534M; free cash flow $668M; ~$200M buybacks.

Stated 2026 focus areas: international growth (directional drilling, unconventionals, well intervention, artificial lift, VoltaGrid power), North America 'Maximize Value' (Zeus IQ e-frac, iCruise, LOGIX automation), deploying digital and automation internally and for customers, ~$1.1B capex, >50% of FCF returned to shareholders, low-carbon growth.
Landmark Software and Services provides cloud-based digital services and AI solutions for subsurface insights, well construction, and reservoir and production management.

Major 2026 wins include Aramco lump-sum turnkey contracts for ~285 onshore wells, a multi-year Aramco unconventional gas stimulation contract, TotalEnergies GranMorgu (Suriname) deepwater integrated drilling/completions, and Basra Oil Company integrated field management (Landmark software supports the Basra contract).
CEO Jeff Miller: 'differentiated technology and value proposition set the stage for revenue growth and margin expansion', with a 'consistent focus on returns and capital discipline'.

tech_posture.fact: Landmark product portfolio showcased at LIFE2025: DecisionSpace 365 suite, Unified Ensemble Modeling (UEM), Agile Asset Management (AAM); plus LOGIX automation/remote ops and ZEUS IQ intelligent fracturing. Miller: 'Digital technologies and automation are central to how we manage and execute our business.'

Acquired InformatiQ AS (Norway), a cloud-native SaaS company (geologiQ 3D field/well digital twin, well planning, regulatory docs, AI-enabled offset well analysis, SAP-integrated logistics via traQ/LogistiQ); framed as reinforcing Landmark's cloud-native delivery and AI-supported insight.
Strategic collaboration with Shape Digital (MODEC spin-off) linking Landmark's Digital Field Solver with Shape Lighthouse/Aura/Reef for AI-driven digital asset performance management.

2026 Technology Showcase (Houston, May 4-7) presented integration of software, AI and automation into real-time operations: live automated frac site, ZEUS IQ, LOGIX closed-loop rig control for drilling and geosteering, OCTIV Auto Frac, automated cementing.

Landmark is hiring 'AI Agent Architect - Industrial AI Systems' (Bengaluru req 210286; also Brazil remote) to build a multi-agent framework with LangChain/AutoGen/CrewAI or custom stacks, LLMs, RAG, Python, on Azure or AWS, integrating engineering tools, simulators and databases.

Landmark iEnergy Stack: private/hybrid E&P cloud running DecisionSpace 365 on-premises, including a 'restricted management' mode with no outbound connectivity; positioned for data sovereignty/residency; OSDU-compliant apps.

Five-year strategic agreement (2020) with Microsoft and Accenture/Avanade to move Halliburton to Azure, migrate all physical data centers to Azure (staged by 2022), and build out the Halliburton Data Lake with ML/AI. Five-year term would have run to ~2025; current status not found.
Internal ERP modernization under way: SAP S/4 migration costs were $50M in Q3 2025 and expected ~$40M in Q4 2025.
CIO leads all IT functions (20+ years at Halliburton); CISO (25+ years experience) reports to the EVP & Chief Administrative Officer and briefs the Board quarterly.

recent_events.fact: Reuters-reported layoffs began ~Sept 2025; insiders said roughly 20%-40% of employees in multiple divisions were cut (company did not disclose full scope).

Q3 2025: $284M of severance and fixed/other asset write-offs; Miller said 'rightsizing our operations and overhead' would cut quarterly labor costs by ~$100M starting Q4 2025; 2026 capex to fall almost 30% to ~$1B.
Leadership reshuffle: Shannon Slocum promoted to EVP & COO (effective Jan 1, 2026, joining the board) with worldwide technology in scope; Rami Yassine named head of Eastern Hemisphere.
Acquired InformatiQ AS to expand Landmark's cloud-native digital capabilities.
Shape Digital strategic collaboration announced for AI asset performance management.
VoltaGrid collaboration: 400 MW of modular natural-gas power for data centers, starting in the Middle East, slated for 2028 delivery.
Q2 2026 rebound: revenue $5.7B (up from $5.4B Q1); Miller expects demand growth in every region.
Chief Accounting Officer change: Stephanie Holzhauser replaced Charles Geer Jr. (effective July 16, 2025).

agent_signals.fact: August 2024 cyber incident: unauthorized access and exfiltration from corporate systems, systems shut down for containment, ~$35M cost; reports attributed it to RansomHub (not confirmed by Halliburton). Older than 12 months but still referenced as material in the FY2025 10-K.
FY2025 10-K risk factors cite AI/ML as competitive technology trends and note AI-driven cyberattacks heighten risk.

Landmark is building multi-agent LLM systems in-house (AI Agent Architect roles in Bengaluru and Brazil, Python, LangChain/AutoGen/CrewAI, Azure/AWS), which shows engineering teams active in agentic AI and a likely build-your-own preference.
Legacy/ERP modernization: SAP S/4 migration consumed $50M in Q3 2025 alone.
Acquisition integration workload: InformatiQ cloud-native SaaS apps (geologiQ already connects to Landmark AAM) must be integrated into Landmark's portfolio.
Sovereignty/air-gapped requirement: Landmark iEnergy Stack offers on-prem deployment with no outbound connectivity and manual patch ingestion for NOC/high-security customers.
Microsoft-centric estate: 2020 agreement migrated all physical data centers to Azure with Accenture/Avanade as SI (stale; current status unverified).
OT/IT convergence: LOGIX closed-loop rig control, ZEUS IQ automated frac and automated cementing link software/AI directly to field equipment in real time.
Cost pressure on labor: ~$100M/quarter labor cost reduction from the rightsizing, increasing pressure to do more engineering work with fewer people.
